core_types.name: Client
core_types.description: GitHub API v3 HTTP client managing authentication, rate limiting, and domain services

core_types.name: Response
core_types.description: Extended http.Response carrying GitHub rate limit and pagination metadata

core_types.name: RateLimits
core_types.description: Snapshot of primary and resource-specific rate limits and reset timestamps

call_paths.path: Client.NewRequest(method, url, body) -> BaseURL resolution + headers
Client.Do(ctx, req, v) -> http.Client.Do() -> checkResponse() -> parseRateLimits()

concurrency_model.type: Stateless Concurrency / Thread-Safe Client Service Instances
concurrency_model.synchronization: Stateless services sharing underlying thread-safe http.Client and Transport

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: context.Context is first parameter to all API methods and propagates to http.RequestWithContext
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Response bodies drained and closed by Client.Do before unmarshaling JSON payloads

retry_model.strategy: Delegated to HTTP RoundTripper or caller; detects 403/429 RateLimitError and AbuseRateLimitError

boundaries.network: GitHub REST API v3 HTTPS endpoints (api.github.com or GitHub Enterprise Server)
boundaries.os: In-memory buffers, local git repository hooks, and kernel network sockets
boundaries.serialization: JSON unmarshaling of GitHub API entity models and webhook payloads
